newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia wants Bre-X/Barrick to announce deal.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia wants Bre-X/Barrick to announce deal.

text.p: Indonesian Mines and Energy Minister Ida Bagus Sudjana said on Thursday he wanted Canada's Bre-X Minerals Ltd and Barrick Gold Corp to announce publicly their agreement on the giant Busang gold find as soon as possible.
"I want them to officially announce they have a deal between them," Sudjana told reporters. "I am waiting for them."
Umar Said, the ministry's secretary-general, said he, Sudjana and government lawyers were studying a letter received last month from Bre-X and Barrick outlining a deal they had reached.
When asked to comment on the letter, Sudjana said: "It is good enough."

Umar said the agreement outlined in the letter gave Bre-X a 22.5 percent stake in the two richest parts of the Busang field in East Kalimantan province, Barrick 67.5 percent and the government 10 percent.
"We are studying the letter together with our lawyers," he told reporters.
Bre-X estimates the Busang find contains at least 57 million ounces of gold worth over $21 billion at current prices.
Asked if the two companies were awaiting guidance from the Indonesian government, Sudjana said: "What guidance? If we offer guidance, they could say we were pushing them."
The minister said he wanted the Busang issued settled as soon as possible.
